_doc: The VT350's print projects for platform/parts/orca_projects.py (#217). Owner 2026-11-20: one OrcaSlicer project per work unit (`units`), a plate per material inside it (each with its own filament preset); the 4-lane Pico MMU lets a plate carry up to `max_filaments` filaments: its material, then `accent` ([a] parts: the same preset, the accent colour's spool) and `clear` ([t] parts: the PETG preset), per `slots`. Docks go with the toolhead (they mate); anything inside the chamber is PET-GF (owner 2026-11-20, #8 AC1); Z is part of kinematics; every e-box part is one `ebox` project in Ambrosia ASA (the owner's `Ambrosia ASA - warmer` preset). `qty`: copies for an 'as-needed' row (LDO cable clips: 1 each, owner 2026-11-20; clone more in Orca); `own_plate`: a plate per clip size (owner). `skip`: rows not placed. Paths are the manifest's (relative to parts/printed/); preset paths are relative to orca/; `bed_mm` is the Neptune 4 Pro's 235 x 235 bed (the vendor machine profile's printable_area).

materials.label: any material (assembly jigs)
materials.filament: filament/E RPETG Red - MMU - cht-mze + bimetal.json

units.kinematics: kinematics: X gantry, belt clips, cable clips, Z carriages, rail stops, rear extrusion brackets (#10, #11)
units.toolhead: toolheads and docks: A4Tv2, MadMax carriage and tool plates, ducts, O2S wire restraints; dock arms and keyslot plates (#11, #12)
units.door: Clicky-Clack door: hinges, handle, latch, panel clip (#9, #14)
units.jigs: assembly jigs: drill guides, rail guides (#9, #10, #11)
units.ebox: e-box: every electronics-bay part, in Ambrosia ASA (owner 2026-11-20): the BTT TMC5160 driver base (#13)

slot_filaments.clear: filament/E RPETG Red - MMU - cht-mze + bimetal.json

skip.voron-trident/z_carriage_rear_2hole.stl: lite-72 builds the Z rear carriage as the 3-hole (Generic) variant: it carries the leadscrew nut, M5 nut, locknuts and screws; the 2-hole (IGUS) body is the unused alternative (owner 2026-11-20: whichever the printer uses; #10 AC4)
